name: text-cursor-proximity
title: Text Cursor Proximity
description: Display text that restyles letter by letter according to how near the pointer is. In the demo the closest letters turn soft and blurred while the rest of the words stay crisp.
use: A bold display headline should respond as the pointer sweeps across it, giving the type a tactile feel.
avoid: It measures every letter on each frame and only answers a pointer, so touch users see plain static text.
a11y: The full text is repeated once for screen readers, but the effect ignores reduced-motion settings. (keyboard: n-a, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A tall electric blue panel on black, with white bold "DIGITAL WORKSHOP" at the top left and five lines of small contact details across the bottom. Letters near the pointer look smeared while the others remain sharp.
behaves: As the pointer moves each letter measures its distance to it and is restyled every frame, so a soft blur travels across the words and fades with distance. Any CSS property pair can drive it, using linear, exponential or gaussian falloff.
customise: The letters are your children; the style pairs to animate, the radius, the falloff curve and the container ref that defines the pointer space are props.
weight: moderate: Every letter's position is measured on each animation frame and fed its own motion value.
